title: Walls on a tile map
description:
Check whether a move is allowed on a tile map.

```
#######
#..@..#
#.###.#
#.....#
#######
move up -> blocked by a wall
move left -> ok, now at (2, 1)
```
hints: Check `y` is between 0 and `map.size() - 1` and `x` within that row before reading `map[y][x]` (lesson 11.02).
Draw the player by copying the row and replacing one character, not by changing the map.
requirements: The map is a `std::vector<std::string>`; `#` blocks movement.
Moves outside the map are blocked too.
Print the map with the player after each move.
stretch: Add doors (`+`) that open when walked into.
